_doc: Machine-readable lane->epic index the ops-monitor (scripts/ops-monitor-check.sh) reads with jq. Join key = epic_id; ready-count per lane = `br ready --parent <epic_id> --limit 0 --json`. A lane is KNOWN/resumable when gate is null or expired; GATED only when a non-null unexpired gate object is present. epic_id:null REQUIRES a non-null gate. Admiral-owned; captain updates on staffing. Update in the SAME action as any lane add/retask/park. 2026-09-07: fleet DOWN, planning turn — no lanes staffed. Direction of record = the platform re-grounding (plans/2026-09-07-harmonik-{bus,restructure}/); staffing is gated on open operator decisions in captain-lanes.md. Re-seed this array only when a lane is stood up on a go/no-go.
